svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-1-transports" name="process-view-level-1-transports"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant F as Farol
 participant T as Transport data [PENDING]
 loop Scheduled import, every N seconds [PENDING]
 F->>T: Reads transport data
 alt Valid data
 T-->>F: Timetables and live data
 F->>F: Saves it as the last valid data, with its time
 else Source down or invalid data
 F->>F: Keeps the last valid data, marks the source as unavailable
 end
 end
 loop Every few seconds while the transport screen is open
 P->>F: Asks for the next transport options home
 alt Source available
 F-->>P: Regular lines and event shuttles, \"Data from HH:MM\"
 else Source unavailable
 F-->>P: Last valid data, \"Data from HH:MM\", warning, event shuttles still shown
 end
 end
 Note over P,T: The transport source is never called inside the participant's request
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
